description: This PHP file defines an event subscriber class 'AuthenticationSubscriber' that manages user authentication states within the OrangeHRM system. It handles request, controller, and exception events to enforce session validity, user activity, and authorization checks. The class integrates with various parts of the framework, such as session management, URL generation, and response handling, to manage authentication flow, including redirecting expired sessions and responding with JSON errors for API requests.

classes.name: AuthenticationSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber handling authentication-related events to enforce session validity, user activity status, and manage session expiration and logout procedures.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping Kernel event constants to the handler methods and priorities.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles the request event; stops propagation if user is not authenticated, potentially leading to redirection or session expiration handling.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Handles the controller event; checks user authentication status, session validity, and determines if redirection or error responses are necessary.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles exceptions; redirects to login on session expiry or returns unauthorized response for API calls.

methods.name: getControllerInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the current controller instance from the event.

methods.name: getSystemUser
methods.description: Fetches the system user object based on the authenticated user ID.

methods.name: isLoggedInUserActive
methods.description: Checks if the system user account is active and not deleted.

methods.name: resolveAuthenticatedUserException
methods.description: Determines if any authentication-related exception should be raised based on user status.

methods.name: hasUserLastModifiedChanged
methods.description: Detects if the user entity's last modified timestamp has changed since last session.

methods.name: refreshUserLastModified
methods.description: Updates the stored last modified timestamp in the user session.

methods.name: getUserLastModifiedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the last modified timestamp from the user entity.

methods.name: logoutCurrentSession
methods.description: Invalidates the current session and updates login flash messages upon authentication failure or session expiration.
